details:
Before the VRChat UI update, build 1885 (2026.3.1), when a user clicks on a friend from the Friends wing, they get to see their name, picture, but also text specifying their current location in the game, whether it is in a world instance or in a private world.

Since the new VRChat update 1885 released, if a user clicks on a friend from the Friends wing on the Quick Menu, users cannot see where their friends are located from the Quick Menu, as that is replaced with the new User Profile, which doesn't show anything else aside from their name, profile picture, status, banner, and bio. This forces users to have to click on their friend's profile to see where they are before deciding to join them.

The Friends wing is supposed to offer users quicker and easier access to their friends from the Quick Menu itself instead of clicking on the Social button to see where they are in the Main Menu. VRChat's recent User Profile update makes the Friends wing on the Quick Menu less effective and more annoying than it was before as it takes away the most useful way to see where a friend is located without having to click to go to the Main Menu, whether through the Social button or through their friend's User Profile. 

Not to mention with this new User Profile update, it would be unwise to click on the Join button to join a friend who is on Green or Blue if users don't know where they are since the Quick Menu only shows the User Profile and no information on their current location. For example, it would be frustrating for those who want to join a friend by clicking on the Join button and then suddenly finding out that their friend is in an Age Gated instance when the user itself is not Age Verified since VRChat does not clearly state where that friend is immediately from the Quick Menu.

Therefore, I request that VRChat brings back the ability for users to see where their friends' current locations are directly from the Quick Menu. It makes the Friends wing in the Quick Menu much more effective in doing its job at offering quicker and easier access to friends. I feel that for the best user experience, the new User Profile should not be shown in the Quick Menu when searching for friends; it should revert back to how the UI was before build 1885, where it shows the user's name, status, a snippet of their bio, their profile pic, and their current location, whether it is either the name of the world they are currently in or if they are in a private world.

If the VRChat team insists on having the new User Profile on the Quick Menu, the least they could do is give enough space in that profile to allow users to see where their friends' current location is from the Quick Menu itself without having to click on their profile to check from the Main Menu.

Image examples are from the current build 1886 to help explain what I mean.
title: Bring back the ability to see friends' current location directly from the Quick Menu
